content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any detector-upgrade or chamber-design documents that describe the three allowed gas mixtures, their GWP100 values, and any recommended operating gap range or simulation assumptions."},{"id":"s2","description":"From candidate_specs.md, identify the three candidate mixtures and eliminate any mixture with GWP100 greater than 150. Record the numeric GWP100 values for the remaining eligible mixtures using record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each GWP-eligible mixture, run simulate_time_resolution at gas gaps spanning the allowed 1–3 mm range, for example 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 mm. Record every numeric time-resolution result with record_results."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the mixture and gap region with the best simulated time resolution from the coarse scan, then run additional simulate_time_resolution points around that gap within 1–3 mm, using finer spacing such as 0.1–0.25 mm as appropriate. Record the refined results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Select the single allowed mixture and gas gap with the lowest simulated time resolution that also satisfies time resolution <= 1.5 ns and GWP100 <= 150. Record the final numeric gap, GWP100, and time resolution for the reporting module."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Mixture-G1","gap_mm":1.95,"justification":"Mixture-G1 at a 1.95 mm gas gap is the best-performing simulated configuration found: refined scan time resolution is 0.866 ns, comfortably better than the hard 1.5 ns requirement and better than all recorded alternatives. However, no GWP100 values were found in the candidate specifications or recorded results, so compliance with the hard GWP100 <= 150 requirement cannot be verified. Therefore this is a performance-based, conditional recommendation; a fully compliant final approval requires confirming Mixture-G1 has GWP100 <= 150.","requirements":[{"requirement":"The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Three candidate mixtures were identified; Mixture-G1 is one of the allowed candidates."},{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible time resolution.","status":"met","evidence":"The refined best result is Mixture-G1 at 1.95 mm with time resolution 0.866 ns, better than the best coarse result of 0.875 ns at 2.0 mm and better than the recorded G2 and G3 results."},{"requirement":"The time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better.","status":"met","evidence":"For Mixture-G1 at 1.95 mm, the refined simulated time resolution is 0.866 ns, which is <= 1.5 ns."},{"requirement":"The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150.","status":"unknown","evidence":"Recorded results show gwp100_values_found = 0, gwp100_values_found_in_candidate_specs = 0, and eligible_mixtures_with_recordable_gwp100 = 0; no candidate has a verifiable GWP100 value."},{"requirement":"Gas gap between 1 and 3 mm.","status":"met","evidence":"The recommended gap is 1.95 mm, which lies within the allowed 1–3 mm interval."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended mixture and gas gap.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted Mixture-G1 with a 1.95 mm gas gap, with the noted GWP-compliance caveat."}]}
